summary: Operator's only web presence is the Ivanhoe Civic League's Facebook page ('Ivanhoe Jubilee Park/Show Grounds (Ivanhoe Civic League)', 1.6K followers), which answers logged-out visitors with a login wall and 'This page isn't available right now'; no posts, About text or rates could be read, and no other operator page was found. Nothing confirmed or changed; the derived hookups/sites/showers/booking values are left as they are.
flags: Could not verify the horse-only question: the operator's Facebook page is unreadable without a login, and no Civic League or county page describes the campground. The entry's note says it is open to the public for general camping; only reviews on Campendium (aggregator) corroborate that, and they report a donation-based fee ($20 recent, $35 in 2023), full-hookup and riverbank dry sites, and a longest reported RV of 19 ft.

Live web presence is weak: a login-walled Facebook page and no price on any operator page. Under the private-campground presence/price rule this may not qualify; phone (276) 235-2101 matches the Campendium listing only.
